Scholarship overview

This joint Leeds–China Scholarship Council route combines university tuition support with CSC maintenance funding. It is intended for eligible Chinese applicants seeking doctoral study at Leeds, and requires the university and CSC application stages to be completed under their separate rules.

Research Areas

  • Eligible Leeds PhD subjects
  • Doctoral research
  • International research training

Leeds offers research degrees through its schools, institutes and doctoral training programmes. Its funding routes include subject-specific studentships, university scholarships and awards with particular nationality or widening participation criteria.
